# Tracking and comparison

Repeat the saved panel and selected routes. Review the exact panel before recurring measurements. Save review time, selection, timezone, schedule and target ceiling. Initial research permission does not authorize recurring provider use. Never add newly discovered providers automatically.

Panel revisions snapshot questions and competitors. Execution revisions snapshot routes, profiles, envelope, samples, language/location and limits. Analysis revisions identify annotation and eligibility methods. Append revisions; runs embed complete snapshots. Reusing a revision id with changed content is invalid.

Full comparison requires matching panel, execution and analysis snapshots. Otherwise explicitly identify the common subset of unchanged questions, brands and compatible profiles. Unknown models cannot establish compatibility. Show competitor changes and exact denominators; never pool incompatible series.

Prefer the host's native scheduler with a saved project/repeat command. Otherwise optional runtime cron support uses absolute paths on Linux/macOS. Windows retains manual repeats. Keep reports outside installation directories.

Recurring jobs require reviewed saved panel/consent, target and time limits, overlap locks, durable occurrence records and stopping after auth/quota failure. Record missed occurrences without catch-up. Retain partial evidence. Changed panels, routes, budgets or schedules need new preview/consent. Never switch accounts, providers or billing silently.
